links.outcome: LLM accuracy on time-specific guideline knowledge, current versus historical recommendations
links.effect: Accuracy on up-to-date knowledge declines linearly over time. Historical knowledge accuracy is only 25.37%-53.89% of up-to-date knowledge. Predictions fluctuate across neighboring years.
links.quote: LLMs consistently struggle more with recalling outdated historical medical knowledge than with up-to-date recommendations: accuracy of historical knowledge is only 25.37%-53.89% of up-to-date knowledge

links.outcome: Effect of agentic search tool integration on temporal awareness accuracy
links.effect: Agentic search did not easily solve the temporal awareness problem; accuracy changes ranged from -3.15% to 14.14%.
links.quote: We also show that the temporal awareness problem is a challenge that cannot be easily solved when integrated with agentic search tools (-3.15%-14.14%).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM temporal awareness in medical knowledge using a benchmark (TempoMed-Bench) and explicitly tests whether integrating agentic search tools mitigates temporal reasoning errors.
